title: Agent chat hardening: thread-scoped streaming patches + persist-on-terminal + memoize markdown
description:
Agent chat hardening (audit of 1290/1291): thread-scoped streaming patches + persist-on-terminal + memoize markdown. Scope: threadStore.ts, AgentChatPanel.tsx, AgentMarkdown.tsx (+tests).

--- COMPLETION EVIDENCE (agent-1293) ---
FIX 1 (thread-scoped patches): threadStore.patchAssistantRun(threadId, assistantId, run) patches an EXPLICIT thread (not activeThreadId). AgentChatPanel captures originThreadId at send time; onState/error/catch patches + history append target it; safety-net useEffect aborts the in-flight AbortController if activeThreadId changes mid-run; if(running) UI guards preserved.
FIX 2 (persist-on-terminal): patchAssistantRun persists to localStorage ONLY on terminal status (done/error/stopped); running deltas are in-memory only (no per-delta thrash). normalizeThread->coerceRunningToTerminal coerces a persisted 'running' run to 'stopped' on hydrate so a mid-run refresh never sticks.
FIX 3 (memo): AgentMarkdown wrapped in React.memo keyed on children string (no re-parse of settled bubbles during streaming).
PRE-EXISTING BLOCKER ALSO FIXED: selectThreadsByRecency returned a fresh sorted array each call -> under zustand v5 'getSnapshot should be cached' -> 'Maximum update depth exceeded' which blanked AgentChatPanel; the agent-chat e2e oracle timed out on baseline too. Wrapped in useShallow. Verified via console-capturing playwright probe: baseline PANEL_COUNT=0 with crash; after fix PANEL_COUNT=1, no errors.
TESTS ADDED: threadStore.test.ts (thread-scoped patch survives active-thread switch; unknown threadId no-op; write-count NOT per-delta + terminal persisted for each of done/error/stopped; hydrate running->stopped; terminal untouched). AgentMarkdown.test.ts (export is React.memo; unchanged children skip re-parse via preserved DOM node identity; changed children still update).
RESULTS:
